investigation_notes.Description: An unusually high volume of SharePoint files (850) was downloaded by the user from the Executive Board Confidential site, far exceeding the 24-hour baseline of 5 files. The access originated from an IP in Tallinn, Estonia and used SharePoint Online as the workload, with a legacy user agent. The combination of sensitive data exposure, large data volume, and cross-border access indicates a elevated risk of data exfiltration or credential misuse, requiring further investigation.
investigation_notes.Geographic Context: City Tallinn, Country Estonia; Local event time approximately 16:45 (UTC+2).
investigation_notes.Volume Context: Downloaded 850 files; baseline 24h prior: 5 files; target site includes Executive Board Confidential documents; sample files include terms and board materials.
investigation_notes.User Role Context: User is Regional Logistics Coordinator (Ireland) in Supply Chain & Logistics; access to confidential board documents appears misaligned with typical role responsibilities.
investigation_notes.Reputation Insight: Source IP 194.126.101.99 shows no abuse signals; Destination IP 40.108.201.15 is a Microsoft data center; traffic aligns with legitimate cloud service usage, but data sensitivity and volume elevate risk.
